plan.archetype: Early damage into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish reliable damage, upgraded poison, sustained defense, and Weak. Reserve strong block for Dismember; bring ample HP and a defensive potion.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage early, then develop poison and dexterity. Remove Strikes as damage improves. Fight elites with adequate damage and potions; heal when needed, otherwise upgrade core cards.
